pairs: Take hold of weapons and a shield,
and rise up in assistance to me.
et conclude adversus eos qui persequuntur me;
and close in on those who persecute me.
Let them be confounded and in awe,
Let them be turned back and be confounded,
who think up evil against me.
Fiant tamquam pulvis ante faciem venti,
May they become like dust before the face of the wind,
and let the Angel of the Lord hem them in.
Fiat via illorum tenebræ et lubricum,
May their way become dark and slippery,
and may the Angel of the Lord pursue them.
Quoniam gratis absconderunt mihi interitum laquei sui;
For, without cause, they have concealed their snare for me unto destruction.
Over nothing, they have rebuked my soul.
Let the snare, of which he is ignorant, come upon him,
et captio quam abscondit apprehendat eum,
and let the deception, which he has hidden, take hold of him:
et in laqueum cadat in ipsum.
and may he fall into that very snare.
Anima autem mea exsultabit in Domino,
But my soul will exult in the Lord
eripiens inopem de manu fortiorum ejus;
He rescues the needy from the hand of the stronger one,
egenum et pauperem a diripientibus eum.
the indigent and the poor from those who plunder him.
interrogating me about things of which I am ignorant.
They repaid me evil for good,
to the deprivation of my soul.
I humbled my soul with fasting,
et oratio mea in sinu meo convertetur.
and my prayer will become my sinews.
Quasi proximum et quasi fratrem nostrum sic complacebam;
Like a neighbor, and like our brother, so did I please;
quasi lugens et contristatus sic humiliabar.
like one mourning and contrite, so was I humbled.
And they have been joyful against me,
Scourges have been gathered over me,
and I was ignorant of it.
They scoffed at me with scorn.
They gnashed their teeth over me.
when will you look down upon me?
Restitue animam meam a malignitate eorum;
Restore my soul from before their malice,
my only one from before the lions.
I will confess to you in a great Church.
I will praise you among a weighty people.
Non supergaudeant mihi qui adversantur mihi inique,
May those who are my unjust adversaries not be glad over me:
those who have hated me without cause,
and who nod agreement with their eyes.
For indeed, they spoke peacefully to me;
and speaking with passion to the earth,
Et dilataverunt super me os suum;
And they opened their mouth wide over me.
Exsurge et intende judicio meo, Deus meus;
Rise up and be attentive to my judgment,
et Dominus meus, in causam meam.
to my cause, my God and my Lord.
Judge me according to your justice, O Lord,
Domine Deus meus, et non supergaudeant mihi.
my God, and do not let them be glad over me.
Do not let them say in their hearts,
Let them blush and be in awe together,
et revereantur simul qui gratulantur malis meis;
those who congratulate at my misfortunes.
Let them be clothed with confusion and awe,
et reverentia qui magna loquuntur super me.
who speak great things against me.
et lætentur qui volunt justitiam meam;
who will the peace of his servant.
Et lingua mea meditabitur justitiam tuam;
And so my tongue will express your justice:
